\section[\texorpdfstring{\ur{مطالعہ} (mutāliā)}{مطالعہ (mutāliā)}]{\ur{مطالعہ} (mutāliā) — a study (a piece of research); close reading}

\label{lesson:UR-C351-mutalia}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Urdu for a rate, then the Urdu for to bring out.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ur{مطالعہ}}
\textbf{\ur{مطالعہ}} — \emph{mutāliā} — \textquotedblleft{}a study (a piece of research); close reading\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\ur{یہ} \ur{مطالعہ} \ur{بچوں} \ur{کی} \ur{نیند} \ur{پر} \ur{ہے۔}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{yih mutāliā bachchoṅ kī nīṅd par hai.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
This study is about children's sleep.
\end{quote}

Masculine.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\ur{مطالعہ}} (\emph{mutāliā}) is usually traced, through Persian, to Arabic \emph{muṭālaʿa}, \textquotedblleft{}perusal, close reading\textquotedblright{}.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for giving reasons and opinions.
\end{grammarlens}

\label{lesson:UR-C351-parakhna}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Urdu for a sample, then the Urdu for to compare.
